title: test_sos_resource.py: Resource leak: client context created but never shut down
description:
In test_retrigger_noop_when_idle (line 269), test_beacon_task_starts_on_activate (line 302), test_beacon_task_stops_on_cancel (line 313), and test_beacon_retriggers_periodically (line 333), the _setup() helper creates both client and server aiocoap contexts, but these tests only shut down the server. The client context (assigned to _) still holds asyncio tasks/transports that are never cleaned up, potentially causing ResourceWarnings, test hangs, or flaky parallel test behavior.

File: python/tests/coap/test_sos_resource.py
Line: 269
close_reason: Already fixed - all tests in test_sos_resource.py properly shut down both client and server aiocoap contexts in finally blocks. Verified by running all 107 tests with -W error::ResourceWarning and no warnings occurred.
